description: This Java source file defines an abstract immutable class AbstractDittoHeaders implementing the DittoHeaders interface. It manages headers as an unmodifiable map, provides various accessors for specific header types (like content type, correlation ID, ETag, etc.), handles serialization/deserialization, and includes methods for truncating headers based on size constraints.

classes.name: AbstractDittoHeaders
classes.description: An abstract immutable implementation of DittoHeaders, managing headers in an unmodifiable map, providing accessors for header fields, serialization, and header size management.

methods.name: keepAuthContextSubjectsWithIssuer
methods.description: Filters authorization subjects in a context to keep only those with an issuer in their ID.

methods.name: getJsonObject
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonObject representation of a header if present, otherwise an empty JsonObject.

methods.name: getJsonArrayForDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonArray from headers for a given header definition.

methods.name: duplicateSubjectsByStrippingIssuerPrefix
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext with subjects having issuer prefixes stripped.

methods.name: getSubjectWithoutIssuer
methods.description: Returns a new AuthorizationSubject with issuer prefix removed from ID if present.
